recommendation.text: The review documents confirm ranolazine was the subject of the December 9, 2003 Cardio-Renal Advisory Committee meeting but do not report the committee's vote or recommendation. The medical review's only account of the committee is the statement of the fact of the meeting; a later section states no additional advisory committee meeting was planned.

quote.quote: No additional advisory committee meeting is planned at the present time.

summary: The FDA review documents for NDA 21-526 (RANEXA/ranolazine) confirm that a Cardio-Renal Advisory Committee meeting was held on December 9, 2003, during the first review cycle (after the October 30, 2003 approvable letter). The available review documents state only the fact that the meeting occurred; they do not report the committee's vote or recommendation, do not record committee-member statements, and do not explicitly tie any committee concern to a specific change in the eventual 2006 approval. Because no review document makes such a concern-to-change connection, no linkages are reported.
